findings.citationQuote: Liquid division runs dropper-fill and pump-fill serum formats; 9 serum programs delivered since 2022.

findings.citationQuote: Our facility is GMP-certified and follows international cosmetic manufacturing standards recognised across our export markets. Certification documentation is maintained internally and can be reviewed during a site visit.

It explicitly states documentation is kept internally and only reviewable during a site visit, meaning no certificate record is actually shown in this document. This is a marketing-style compliance claim only, not a certificate record.

findings.citationQuote: Serums and treatment liquids: 12,000 units per SKU.
